sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def sqpos():
    A=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    S=[(i,j) for i in range(64) for j in range(64) if A[i][j]=='S']
    rows=sorted(set(i for i,j in S)); cols=sorted(set(j for i,j in S))
    return (rows[0],rows[-1],cols[0],cols[-1])
def barfronts():
    A=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    top=[j for j in range(64) if A[0][j]=='W']; bot=[j for j in range(64) if A[63][j]=='W']
    return (top[-1] if top else None, bot[0] if bot else None)
print("start", sqpos(), barfronts())
for k in range(6):
    r=action(['UP'])
    print("UP",k, sqpos(), barfronts(), "GO" if r.get('game_over') else "", "LC" if r.get('level_completed') else "")
    if r.get('game_over') or r.get('level_completed') or r.get('done'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
